story.visualIntent: 交给用户四格漫画折页，2×2按左上→右上→左下→右下：1戴浅黄叶帽的普通成年刺猬在小洞口喊，气泡原样“喂？”；2探进一小步、洞深处卷风出现，两个回声气泡原样“喂？”、“喂？”；3背刺变为三团圆螺旋、奶白短吻和四足不变，帽子延续，气泡原样“咦！”；4同一卷刺刺猬倒退到洞外、身向洞而回头看路，气泡原样“先退一步。”。漫画给用户看完整因果；特殊形态另由appearance体现，不能仅用漫画代替。
story.connection: 采用当日冒险与漫画明确请求。先前一周的追痕、空壳、蝉蜕与帽子来自宠物冻结设计经历；回声洞和身体反应为宠物世界虚构，没有用户持续模式或实际到访事实。
story.text: 这周它追过蜗牛的亮线，看过空壳，也带回过抱枝的蝉蜕。今天，草坡后那个会回声的小洞成了新去处。你想看冒险并收到漫画，刺猬就戴着昨天的浅黄小圆叶帽，在洞口喊了一声。里面回了两声。它先探看，再往里挪一小步；一阵旋风从洞底绕上来，把背上的软刺卷成了三团大大的圆螺旋。暖棕身体、奶白短吻和四只肉足都还在，只是每落一步，卷刺就轻轻颤一下。它倒着退到洞口，帽子仍稳稳戴着，回声还在里面追它。回家后，它把喊声、回声、卷刺、倒退这四步画成四格漫画给你，折好放在照片下面。画最后一格时，它背上的三团卷刺又抖了一下，纸上多出一条弯线。

completed.home: 家仍在苔石边，草根蜗牛小路接着苔石外沿的走动与观察空地。半片乳白浅褐斑蛋壳挡风，大叶雨檐遮雨；内侧草垫小窝和床边干草供休息。凹叶里原种子不变；半壳内侧干草旁两端一颗与两颗浅泥点的弯木片及其旁的天然半月凹口浅灰扁石不变。木片后方干处平放苔石坡明信片，标本屋照片在明信片下方并错开窄白边；本次新增四格漫画折页，折好放在照片下面，成为纸藏品底层。收藏区侧边仍架着短枝，淡琥珀空蝉蜕仍扣着枝、悬空不受压。相机已归还，浅黄帽仍随宠物穿戴。没有搬家或改变原分区。
completed.special: 回声卷刺形态：成年刺猬背部原有钝圆软刺聚拢卷成三团大圆螺旋，轮廓像沿拱背排列的三簇柔软卷环，迈步时轻颤。暖棕低矮躯干、奶白短吻腹、四短肉足、双圆耳和亮眼延续，浅黄小圆叶帽继续戴着。变化在器官形状而非换色，仍是同一只可爱活刺猬。

visuals.request:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a pet's four-panel comic leaflet given to the user.
Primary request: Draw exactly FOUR clearly separated comic panels in a square 1:1 unfolded cream-paper leaflet, a 2×2 grid with wide clear gutters and fine dark panel borders. Read left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row. No title or extra panels. Each panel has one large clear action and a readable Simplified Chinese speech bubble. Keep the same cute compact pixel-art adult warm-brown hedgehog body, cream muzzle and belly, dark glossy eyes, round ears and four short fleshy feet throughout; the same pale-yellow low round leaf hat, narrow brim and simple grass-fibre band stays on its head in ALL FOUR PANELS, both ears exposed.
Panel 1, TOP LEFT: outside a small dark cave in a grassy slope, the NORMAL adult hedgehog with blunt soft spine clusters stands facing the cave mouth and calls inside. ONE speech bubble from the hedgehog with EXACT text 喂？
Panel 2, TOP RIGHT: same NORMAL hedgehog takes only one small step into the cave; a plainly visible curling gust rises from the dark cave depths toward its back. TWO distinct echo speech bubbles come FROM DEEP INSIDE THE CAVE, each with EXACT text 喂？ and 喂？. Its back is still the ordinary uncurled spine clusters in this panel.
Panel 3, BOTTOM LEFT: the gust has turned its back spines into EXACTLY THREE LARGE ROUND SPIRAL TUFTS, attached to the same living body. The cream muzzle and all four short feet are still visible, hat stays the same. Show a surprised reaction and one bubble with EXACT text 咦！
Panel 4, BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME THREE-SPIRAL hedgehog backs OUT through the cave entrance; its BODY FACES TOWARD THE CAVE INTERIOR while its head turns backward to look at the path outside. It retreats feet-first/backward rather than walking toward the cave. Keep three spiral tufts and hat visible. ONE bubble from the pet with EXACT text 先退一步。
Art: cute cartoon pixel comic with crisp blocky colour shapes, sparse backgrounds, warm brown and cream pet, pale-yellow hat, moss-green grass and dark-earth cave. Make the regular-to-three-spiral transformation clear and retain the same identity. Simplified Chinese bubble text must be large, clean, exact, with punctuation as written. The only image text is these five bubble utterances; no numerals, arrows, labels, captions or other writing. Physical leaflet alone on plain neutral backing, complete paper edges visible, opaque. Input image 1 is the accepted ordinary-hatted hedgehog identity for panels 1 and 2. Input image 2 is the accepted same pet with three spiral tufts for panels 3 and 4. Match its THREE large upright spiral tufts along the back, integrated into the same hedgehog body, with the same cream-tipped curled layers and brown palette. Use both images only as character identities, not as panel backgrounds.

visuals.request:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: one transparent static cartoon pixel Pet Avatar for 192 by 208 display.
Primary request: Edit the supplied SAME adult hedgehog wearing its pale yellow low round leaf hat into its temporary echo-curled-quill form. Change ONLY the dorsal quills: the previous blunt little quill clusters gather into EXACTLY THREE BIG SOFT ROUND SPIRAL CURL CLUSTERS growing out of the same arched back. Show three separate rounded spiral silhouettes arranged sequentially along the back, from rump at left to upper back behind the head at right. Each is a thick softly curled biological quill tuft with a clearly readable spiral groove, warm brown and tan with cream edge tips. These replace the old upright quill spikes, not stickers laid over unchanged spikes. Make the rounded rolls obvious at small size, like three soft coils that could gently tremble while walking, not snail shells, mechanical springs or separate objects.
Identity invariants: retain the supplied low compact warm tan-brown arched body, cream-white face, short projecting snout and belly, two dark glossy eyes, brown nose, pink inner ears, all four short pink fleshy feet, same mature proportions, same three-quarter stance facing right and friendly expression. Keep the exact existing pale yellow shallow round leaf hat, narrow brim and single simple grass-fiber securing circle. Both ears remain visible at the sides; face, belly and limbs are unobscured. Do not add garments, items or extra limbs. Color remains warm brown and cream; the change is quill ORGAN SHAPE, not recoloring.
Style: match the coarse crisp cartoon pixel grid of the reference, compact approachable living creature silhouette, broad simple color blocks, stepped outline. No fine strands, realistic textures, smooth painting, furry rendering or decorative effects.
Composition: one full-body character centered with ample transparent margins; all three coils and whole hat visible, no wind lines or text. Genuine transparent PNG, no scenery, floor, background, border, props or shadow blob. One base Avatar, not an animation atlas.
